PYTHON ?= python3
export DOC
LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS := check
LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_0 := 
LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_1 := 
LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_2 := 
LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_3 := 
LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_4 := 
LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_5 := 
LATEX_AI_CHECK_PARENTS = $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_0)),pdf) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_1)),doctor) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_2)),status) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_3)),help) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_4)),validate) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_CHECK_DEPS_5)),clean)
$(foreach LATEX_AI_GRAPH_STEP,0 1 2 3 4 5 6,$(eval LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS := $(sort $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS) $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_PARENTS))))
ifneq ($(filter manuscript,$(or $(DOC),manuscript))$(filter $(LATEX_AI_CHECK_GOALS),$(or $(MAKECMDGOALS),$(.DEFAULT_GOAL))),)
.PHONY: latex-ai-integrity latex-ai-check-passed build lint check
LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS := build check latex-ai-build latex-ai-check-passed latex-ai-integrity
LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_0 := 
LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_1 := 
LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_2 := 
LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_3 := 
LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_4 := 
LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_5 := 
LATEX_AI_BUILD_PARENTS = $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_0)),pdf) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_1)),doctor) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_2)),status) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_3)),help) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_4)),validate) $(if $(filter $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS),$(LATEX_AI_BUILD_DEPS_5)),clean)
$(foreach LATEX_AI_GRAPH_STEP,0 1 2 3 4 5 6,$(eval LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS := $(sort $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS) $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_PARENTS))))
LATEX_AI_RECIPE_SHELL := $(SHELL)
LATEX_AI_RECIPE_FLAGS := $(.SHELLFLAGS)
ifneq ($(filter $(LATEX_AI_BUILD_GOALS),$(or $(MAKECMDGOALS),$(.DEFAULT_GOAL))),)
ifeq ($(filter extra-prereqs,$(.FEATURES)),)
$(error Adopted build receipts require GNU Make 4.3 or later with extra-prereqs)
endif
.EXTRA_PREREQS += | latex-ai-build-prepare
pdf: .EXTRA_PREREQS += | latex-ai-build-prepare
pdf: override SHELL := /bin/sh
pdf: override .SHELLFLAGS = .latex-ai/recipe-shell.sh $(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py build-shell --shell-arguments $(LATEX_AI_RECIPE_SHELL) $(LATEX_AI_RECIPE_FLAGS)
endif
.PHONY: latex-ai-build-prepare latex-ai-build
ifneq ($(filter extra-prereqs,$(.FEATURES)),)
latex-ai-build-prepare: private override SHELL := $(LATEX_AI_RECIPE_SHELL)
latex-ai-build-prepare: private override .SHELLFLAGS := $(LATEX_AI_RECIPE_FLAGS)
endif
latex-ai-build-prepare: .EXTRA_PREREQS =
latex-ai-build-prepare:
	+@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py build-prepare --build-owner "$$PPID"
latex-ai-build: pdf latex-ai-build-prepare
	+@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py build-finish --build-owner "$$PPID"
build: latex-ai-build
lint:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py lint
latex-ai-integrity: latex-ai-build
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py verify
latex-ai-check-passed: latex-ai-integrity lint
	@echo "Workbench checks passed: build, integrity, lint"
check: latex-ai-check-passed
else
.PHONY: latex-ai-build latex-ai-named-check
latex-ai-build:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py build --document "$$DOC"
latex-ai-named-check:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py check
check: latex-ai-named-check
endif
export ISSUE_NOTE ISSUE_COMMAND
export DOC
.PHONY: latex-ai-validate
latex-ai-validate:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py validate
.PHONY: latex-ai-plan
latex-ai-plan:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py plan
.PHONY: validation-plan
validation-plan: latex-ai-plan
.PHONY: latex-ai-status
latex-ai-status:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py status
.PHONY: latex-ai-doctor
latex-ai-doctor:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py doctor
.PHONY: latex-ai-help
latex-ai-help:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py help
.PHONY: latex-ai-guide
latex-ai-guide:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py guide
.PHONY: guide
guide: latex-ai-guide
.PHONY: latex-ai-lint
latex-ai-lint:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py lint --document "$$DOC"
.PHONY: document-lint
document-lint: latex-ai-lint
.PHONY: latex-ai-documents
latex-ai-documents:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py documents
.PHONY: documents
documents: latex-ai-documents
.PHONY: latex-ai-document-check
latex-ai-document-check:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py document-check --document "$$DOC"
.PHONY: document-check
document-check: latex-ai-document-check
.PHONY: latex-ai-lint-baseline
latex-ai-lint-baseline:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py lint-baseline --document "$$DOC"
.PHONY: lint-baseline
lint-baseline: latex-ai-lint-baseline
.PHONY: latex-ai-bib-check
latex-ai-bib-check:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py bib-check --document "$$DOC"
.PHONY: bib-check
bib-check: latex-ai-bib-check
.PHONY: latex-ai-pdf-artifact
latex-ai-pdf-artifact:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py artifact --document "$$DOC"
.PHONY: pdf-artifact
pdf-artifact: latex-ai-pdf-artifact
.PHONY: latex-ai-clean
latex-ai-clean:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py clean --document "$$DOC"
.PHONY: latex-ai-modules
latex-ai-modules:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py modules
.PHONY: modules
modules: latex-ai-modules
.PHONY: latex-ai-issue
latex-ai-issue:
	@$(PYTHON) .latex-ai/workbench.py issue --note "$$ISSUE_NOTE" --command "$$ISSUE_COMMAND"
.PHONY: issue
issue: latex-ai-issue
